items.title: iii) Motion of particles in solids (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: iii) Motion of particles in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Solid ke particles na ek jagah se doosri jagah jate hain (translatory motion), na ghoomte hain (rotational motion). Woh sirf apni mean position ke gird vibrate karte hain. Temperature barhne par yeh vibration tez ho jata hai.
